name: McGill University
summary: English-language university in Montreal, founded 1821: about 28,000 undergraduates, 11 faculties, downtown campus plus Macdonald campus.

ib.text: Diploma with 5+ in every HL and SL subject is the minimum for most programs; admitted ranges run from 28 to 42 subject points by faculty. Maths AI SL does not count as a prerequisite.

dates.label: Application deadline, overseas and US high school applicants

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: Design, build and operate mechanical systems, from bicycles to spacecraft, with three areas of specialization: Design, Aeronautics and Mechatronics. Prepares for aerospace, energy, manufacturing and robotics work.
programmes.ib: Maths, Chemistry and Physics, each at HL or SL with at least one at HL; Maths AI SL not accepted. Admitted: 38 to 42 subject points, 6 in each math and science.

needs.note: At least one of Maths, Chemistry, Physics must be HL

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on predicted IB results, then final results; the 38 to 42 range is a guideline from recent years, not a rule for 2027, and minimums shift every year.

flagshipSource.title: Engineering faculty statistics: ten undergraduate degrees; Mechanical had 187 graduates in 2022-23

programmes.name: Bachelor of Commerce (Desautels Faculty of Management)
programmes.about: A management degree that pairs a disciplinary foundation with room to personalise your courses, taught by an international faculty. The 120-credit programme shortens when IB advanced standing is granted.
programmes.ib: Maths AA or AI at HL, or AA at SL with a 6 or 7; Maths AI SL not accepted. Admitted range 35 to 38 subject points, with a 5 in HL Maths or a 6 in SL Maths.

needs.note: SL Maths AA needs a 6 or 7; HL Maths AA or AI needs a 5

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on predicted IB results, then final results; the 35 to 38 range is a guideline from recent years, not a rule for 2027. Up to 30 advanced-standing credits for the Diploma.

flagshipSource.title: Desautels BCom: international and interdisciplinary programme with a flexible, personalised structure

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: No set subject prerequisites; admitted range 33 to 36 subject points. Psychology and Population & Global Health apply separately.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Maths and two lab sciences, one at HL; admitted ranges 35 to 39 subject points depending on the group of programs.

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering
faculties.line: Maths, Chemistry and Physics with one at HL; 32 to 42 subject points by discipline, highest for Bioengineering and Mechanical.

faculties.name: Desautels Faculty of Management
faculties.line: Maths HL (AA or AI), or SL AA with a 6 or 7; admitted range 35 to 38 subject points.

faculties.name: School of Architecture
faculties.line: Maths and Physics with one at HL; the highest range of any faculty, 39 to 42 subject points with 6 or 7 in maths and science.

faculties.name: Faculty of Agricultural and Environmental Sciences
faculties.line: Maths and two lab sciences; admitted range 28 to 30 subject points. Taught on the Macdonald campus.

faculties.name: Faculty of Education
faculties.line: Around 30 subject points; some programs add a language test, and TESL placements may be in French-speaking schools.

faculties.name: School of Nursing
faculties.line: Maths and two lab sciences, 30 subject points; proof of French proficiency is required.

faculties.name: Schulich School of Music
faculties.line: Admission follows the Music faculty's own audition-based requirements; the application deadline is the same 15 January.

notes: McGill teaches in English and does not ask for French in most programs; Nursing asks for proof of French proficiency, and Education placements may be in French-speaking schools.
IB English A at grade 5 or better waives the English proficiency test.
International tuition at McGill is set per program and guaranteed per credit for the length of the programme; student fees and health insurance are charged on top.
